data.notes: February 2026 was unusually stacked for Buenos Aires, with global pop/urban arena runs, Carnival-week electronic festivals, and local summer festival programming overlapping across the city.

events.title: 5to Festival Electrotango Buenos Aires
events.summary: The fifth edition of Festival Electrotango ran for three nights in San Telmo, with Tanghetto, Tangorra, Otros Aires, Ultratango, Narcotango, El Cachivache and DJs/performers across shows and milongas.

events.title: Doja Cat — Ma Vie World Tour
events.summary: Doja Cat played Movistar Arena Buenos Aires on her Ma Vie World Tour, a major arena date for the U.S. rapper and pop artist.

events.title: Kali Uchis — The Sincerely Tour
events.summary: Kali Uchis returned to Buenos Aires for a Movistar Arena show tied to The Sincerely Tour, following earlier Argentina festival appearances.

events.title: Yandel Sinfónico
events.summary: Yandel brought his orchestral-format “Yandel Sinfónico” show to Movistar Arena, reframing reggaetón hits with symphonic arrangements.

events.title: Bad Bunny — DeBÍ TiRAR MáS FOToS World Tour
events.summary: Bad Bunny played three Buenos Aires stadium dates at Estadio River Plate/Mâs Monumental as part of the DeBÍ TiRAR MáS FOToS World Tour.

events.title: Ultra Buenos Aires 2026
events.summary: Ultra Buenos Aires returned to Parque de la Ciudad for a two-day electronic festival, with official billing including Zedd, Alesso, Above & Beyond, deadmau5, Charlotte de Witte, Richie Hawtin, Dom Dolla, CamelPhat and more.

events.title: Fiesta Bomba de Carnaval 2026
events.summary: La Bomba de Tiempo staged its Carnival party at Konex after the regular Lunes Bomba show, with a live La Bomba performance, DJs and invited artists running into the Tuesday holiday morning.

events.title: RÜFÜS DU SOL
events.summary: Australian electronic trio RÜFÜS DU SOL played a Buenos Aires arena date at Movistar Arena, following their recent South American festival momentum.

events.title: Festival Buena Vibra 2026
events.summary: The summer indie festival returned to Ciudad Universitaria with Wos, El Kuelgue, Conociendo Rusia, Marilina Bertoldi, Usted Señalemelo, Emmanuel Horvilleur, Gauchito Club, Silvestre y La Naranja and more.

events.title: Ricardo Montaner — El Último Regreso World Tour opening night
events.summary: Ricardo Montaner opened his El Último Regreso World Tour in Buenos Aires at Movistar Arena, beginning a run of Argentine dates with his decades-spanning Latin pop catalog.

events.title: Chayanne — Bailemos Otra Vez Tour opening Buenos Aires date
events.summary: Chayanne returned to Argentina after more than five years, opening his Buenos Aires run at Movistar Arena with the Bailemos Otra Vez Tour.

events.title: Zaz
events.summary: French singer Zaz returned to Argentina for a Teatro Gran Rex concert, bringing her chanson-pop, soul and jazz-influenced repertoire back to Buenos Aires.
